text: This chapter covers 4-part 4ths in C Harmonic Minor across all 6 cycles. The chapter defines the two parallel voice-leading frameworks (intervallic and functional) and shows the 'c.t.' (common tone) notation as a distinct voice-leading category within the Drop 2 voicing on Cycle 2 — three voices hold while the 7th leaps a 4th. Cycle 4 4-way close on melodic-minor terrain shows cross-voice functional resolutions (7 → 2, 3 → 1, 2 → 7, 1 → 3). The chapter is an extended drill cycle through every voicing type of the harmonic-minor harmonic landscape.
